assumptions: Each bead population carries one metal, so every other signal on it is spill (plus background).
The bead panel covers the masses of the file to compensate; a channel with no beads keeps its identity row.
limits: Compensating a file is done from the panel (flowCore inverse or NNLS); this door returns the matrix.
bio.jane/contract.question: How much does each metal channel of this mass cytometry panel spill into the others?

description: CATALYST bead-based spillover for mass cytometry from a single-stained bead FCS file in the project: the beads debarcoded to their stained mass (one population per mass, each separation cutoff estimated from its yield curve), then each stained channel's spill into the channels it can physically reach (one mass up or down, its oxide at +16, its element's other isotopes from NIST) as the median per-bead ratio of background-corrected receiver to spiller (or the classic ratio of trimmed means); spills below 1e-5 set to 0.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

beads.description: the single-stained bead FCS file in the project, by name or id.

document.description: an FCS file to fit the matrix to (its metal channels); empty for none.

interactions.description: the channel pairs estimated: the physically possible ones, or every pair. Values: default (physical), all (every pair).

masses.description: the stained masses, one bead population each, as ranges: 139, 141-156, 158-176.

spill_estimator.description: computeSpillmat's estimator: per-bead ratios (default) or trimmed means (classic). Values: default (per bead), classic (classic).

name: estimate_cytof_spillover

populations.description: per stained mass, its channel and the beads assigned to it

spillover.description: the matrix: stained channels (rows) into every metal channel (columns), row-major
